panels.description: pending_block_bytes is the amount of data loaded from the sequencer but not yet in a channel. pending_da_bytes is the estimated DA size after compression, and controls the throttling feature. Threshold is usually at 1MB.

panels.description: If blob base fee is > 16x base fee, consider switching from blobs to calldata (this will be automatic if the batcher is configured for auto DA selection). Note that the batcher's internal DA switching logic uses a more involved calculation than the dashboard so may not switch DA type precisely when the panel would indicate it should -- see batcher logs filtered for cost_ratio.
panels.title: Basefee & suggested tip cap [log(wei)]

panels.description:
"changing DA type" events: These events fire when, as a channel is about to be submitted, the batcher detects that it would be cheaper to send using a different DA layer (calldata or blobs). The blocks in the channel are requeued and a new channel is built on the fly.

"seequencer did not make expected progress" events: when the batcher detects that the sequencer has derived from batches it has posted but the safe head did not advance as expected. May indicate a violation of Holocene derivation rules.

"Pending bytes over limit, throttling DA" events: when pending DA bytes is over the limit, the batcher signals to the sequencer to throttle it.

targets.expr: {container="op-batcher", network="$network"} |= `changing DA type` or `expected progress` or `throttling DA` or `lvl=error` or `endpoints will be throttled` | logfmt | label_format level=detected_level
